subject: USAGE clause
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (kb/Work PB95, found landing PB79): `[USAGE IS] usage-keyword` is ONE alternative over ONE usageKeyword rule - the USAGE keyword is optional for EVERY usage. RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB848 (this verdict had stood while the format was violated): on the RENDERED folio 503 TO is not underlined in `POINTER [ TO type-name-1 ]`, `FUNCTION-POINTER TO function-prototype-name-1` or `PROGRAM-POINTER [ TO program-prototype-name-1 ]`, and OF is not underlined in OBJECT REFERENCE's `[ FACTORY OF ]` - all four were REQUIRED by the grammar. Now `KEYWORD (TO cobolWord | {pointerOperandHere()}? cobolWord)?` and `(FACTORY OF?)?`. The binder reads the operand's presence, never TO's. RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB4235 (this verdict stood while the TO-less operand was refused for legal source): the TO-less operand's guard excluded the context-free FOLLOW(usageKeyword), the union over the data, report group and screen description entries, so a type-name or prototype-name spelled with one of the thirteen section 8.10 screen words (AUTO, BELL, SECURE ...; user-defined words outside the screen description entry, section 8.3.2.1 3)) drew a false COBOL1941 in a data description entry. pointerOperandHere now walks what follows the pointer rule's end through the parser's live rule-invocation stack (CobolParserCoreBase.KeywordContinuesFrom, shared with keywordContinuesHere), so each entry excludes only its own clause words. RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB3517 (this verdict again stood while the format was violated, the other direction): the clause's four optional phrases are parsed after EVERY usage word, and the SIGNED / UNSIGNED phrase, which folio 503 prints only after BINARY-CHAR/-SHORT/-LONG/-DOUBLE (SIGNED not underlined, UNSIGNED underlined), was never narrowed, so `USAGE COMP UNSIGNED` compiled clean with the word ignored. Which usage each phrase may follow is now ONE table, UsagePhraseRules (SIGNED/UNSIGNED COBOL4733, WITH NO SIGN COBOL1565, endianness-phrase COBOL1716, encoding-phrase COBOL1717), read by ONE method, DataBinder.ScreenUsagePhrases; UsageClausePhraseDriftTests checks the table against the printed figure for every grammar usage word. retired-witness: unit:PointerUsageOperandDriftTests.AClauseLeadingKeyword_IsNeverTheToLessOperand (kb/Work PB4235 replaced it: it pinned the context-free FOLLOW(usageKeyword) and demanded an EMPTY operand for every word in it, including the section 8.10 screen words that are user-defined words in a data description entry; TheToLessOperand_IsEveryWordThatDoesNotFollowTheUsageInItsEntry states the per-entry IFF over every word cobolWord admits)
